sources.ref: Topping Home web app v1.17.0 (https://home.toppingaudio.com/): the D900's session and capability check, its 10 configs and its frequency limit

meta.notes: As topping-home, with frequencies up to 22000 Hz. Up to 10 stored configs. The firmware minimum is the one on Topping's page; the app checks no version, it refuses a device whose capabilities answer is not the one it expects, and so does the handler. The app keeps the config's 11th band as it read it; the handler writes it back the same way. The product name is a guess: the app tells its devices apart by a product name it strips of spaces and case, so the exact string a device reports is not known until one is read.
